changes.title: Street litter accumulates
changes.story: Cigarette butts, discarded items pile in gutters. No one picks them up yet.

changes.title: Ilm water quality declines
changes.story: Dumping into the river begins. Banks show signs of stress. Still clear but darkening.

changes.title: One recycling point appears
changes.story: A single sorted recycling bin installed. One person uses it. Lonely but hopeful.

entry.thought: Water waste accelerates while one recycling point stands alone. Pollution spreads into the Ilm as car culture dominates. A split deepens between care and carele
entry.headline: Weimar splits: consumption rises, waste spreads, Ilm drowns

changes.title: Hose washing spreads
changes.story: Pavements washed daily with hoses; water runs into streets and drains. Spreads from Goethe's House and Herderkirche across the town.

changes.title: Traffic consolidates
changes.story: Cars dominate movement. Parking expands. Fumes settle over central streets. Few bikes, many engines.

changes.title: Ilm toxicity rises
changes.story: Car wash runoff, trash dumping accelerate. Water darkens. Banks show litter. Fish numbers drop. A visible scar.

surprise.title: The Ilm runs backwards
surprise.story: In 2071, a pump failure reversed the Ilm's flow. Now it backs up into streets near Goetheplatz, carrying industrial sludge from downstream. Nobody fixed it.

entry.headline: Weimar consumed itself: a town of waste, drought, and broken water
entry.outlook: Weimar is a drought-stricken town of abandoned streets, toxic water, and parched earth, where one recycling bin symbolizes decades of ignored warnings.

changes.title: Ilm reversal and stagnation
changes.story: The Ilm no longer flows naturally. Polluted water pools, spreads into streets.

changes.title: Goetheplatz: waste and flood
changes.story: Litter piles block drainage. Ilm backflow floods the square. The lone recycling station is submerged.

changes.title: Schiller's House: drought and pools
changes.story: Private pools drain groundwater. Gardens dead. Lawns watered at noon burn anyway. Aquifer stress visible.
